title: HOW do carved stone wheels calculate exact solar time accurate to the minute? #Shorts
description:
HOW do carved stone wheels calculate exact solar time accurate to the minute?

The 24 wheels are not decorative. Each wheel represents an hour dial; the 8 major spokes divide 24 hours into 3-hour praharas, while the 8 minor spokes and 60 carved beads between them allow calculating exact solar time down to minutes and seconds based on shadow width.

Produced by ARIA Sacred Heritage AI. Subscribe for the full 52-minute documentary.
